visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of vibrant pink cherry blossoms swaying gently in the breeze. A young woman with long dark hair and a white long-sleeve top is partially visible as she walks beneath the flowering trees. The background features lush green tea bushes organized in neat, tiered rows under bright natural daylight. (2) A breathtaking drone shot reveals the vast expanse of the terraced tea plantation on a steep hillside. A distinct path lined with pink cherry trees cuts through the verdant landscape, creating a color contrast. Several tourists are visible walking along the path, enjoying the scenic mountain views under a clear, sunny sky. (3) The female protagonist is shown walking through the high tea bushes, her face glowing with a bright smile and high-arousal expression. She wears a white blouse and light-colored shorts. The camera uses a mix of medium shots and panning movements to capture her interaction with the surrounding nature and the soft, warm lighting. (4) A young man wearing a white shirt and a wide-brimmed khaki hat joins the woman. They pose together happily, pointing towards the mountain scenery. The camera captures them in a medium full shot with the stunning backdrop of the tea garden and distant blue mountains, emphasizing the depth of the setting. (5) The sequence concludes with close-up shots of individual cherry blossom flowers, highlighting their delicate pink petals and yellow centers. The scene then transitions back to a wide aerial view of the entire valley, showing the winding road and infrastructure leading to the site, with yellow text overlays appearing at the bottom.
